instruction: Could you help me access the Add-ons Manager in Thunderbird? I need to view the extensions and add-ons management page.

metadata.explanation: Task requires opening the Add-ons Manager tab in Thunderbird. The evaluator checks the accessibility tree for a tab named 'Add-ons Manager' within the Thunderbird tab list. This maintains the same task complexity pattern.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly uses accessibility_tree getter to extract UI state, which can detect the presence of tabs in Thunderbird
Metric function check_accessibility_tree properly searches for specific elements using CSS selectors and returns 1.0 if found, 0.0 if not found
CSS selector 'application[name=Thunderbird] page-tab-list[attr|id="tabmail-tabs"]>page-tab[name="Add-ons Manager"]' correctly targets the Add-ons Manager tab within Thunderbird's tab list
Evaluator provides complete coverage of the instruction requirement: verifying that the Add-ons Manager tab is open and accessible
No postconfig needed as tabs remain open after task completion, ensuring state is accessible at evaluation time
Logic handles edge cases correctly: returns 0.0 if tab not opened, 1.0 if tab is present in accessibility tree
